_doc: Permanent self-test mutants (bead cq-w0-chk-selftest; CLAUDE.md 'The §6 checker', Self-test).
Each mutant is a CQ_spec reference lowered.ll with the listed edits applied in order, written under
$CQ_BUILD_DIR/mutants/<id>/ by checker/cqcheck/mutants.py. Each edit's 'old' must occur exactly once
in the text as it stands (with "all": true, at least once, every occurrence replaced). A mutant that
no longer applies after a re-pin is an error, never skipped.
'class' is a key of mutants.CLASSES, which gives the rejection the class predicts: the pattern some
reason of the reference check must match, and the one for the C-oracle check (or none when the
class is invisible to the C program, e.g. a kept rail).

mutants.note: x > k ? x + a : x * b becomes x > k ? x * b : x + a: the measured result changes
b after the swap takes the other arm: the measured b changes (the rule 6 recomputation then also leaves dirt)
x == k becomes x != k, forward and uncompute alike: the phase fires on the complement
x > k becomes x <= k in both functions: the controlled Ry fires on the complement
the x < m rail is freed without its uncompute
the reverse loop frees x * a + b without uncomputing it
the comparison rail is freed twice

edits.old: call void @cqrt_free(i32 %9)    ; IR: release the %7 rail (|0>)
edits.new:
call void @cqrt_free(i32 %9)    ; IR: release the %7 rail (|0>)
  call void @cqrt_free(i32 %9)

mutants.note: the rotated register r is freed while live, then measured
the uncomputed comparison rail is never freed: an extra kept rail reading 0
rule 6's old counter rail (|0> after the copy; trip 0: the incoming 0) is never freed: extra kept rails reading 0
the clone's x * x rail is neither uncomputed nor freed: an entangled garbage rail live at exit, a leak by CR §6 item 1 (cq-tt2j); the sign rail @signflag holds stays an output
the controlled Ry takes the first rotation's angle
the closing Ry(-pi/2) is off by a few ulps
the nested phase takes the outer phase's angle
Ry on q2 controlled by q0 instead of q0 && q1
the in-loop controlled Ry on r is controlled by the previous trip's predicate
the else arm's Ry loses its NOT bracket: controlled by x > k instead of its negation

edits.old: call void @cqrt_not_i1(i32 %8)    ; IR: bracket: block %12 runs under NOT %8

mutants.note: the Ry on r is controlled by NOT f instead of f

edits.new:
call void @cqrt_not_i1(i32 %12)
  call void @cqrt_ry_i32_controlled(i32 %12, i32 %15, double %8)
  call void @cqrt_not_i1(i32 %12)

mutants.note: y's Ry is dropped
the outer branch phase is dropped
x's Ry is applied twice

edits.new:
call void @cqrt_ry_i32(i32 %5, double %1)
  call void @cqrt_ry_i32(i32 %5, double %1)

mutants.note: an extra uncontrolled Ry on q2 after the controlled one

edits.new:
call void @cqrt_ry_i1_controlled(i32 %6, i32 %7, double %2)
  call void @cqrt_ry_i1(i32 %7, double %0)

mutants.note: the then arm's controlled Ry is applied twice

edits.new:
call void @cqrt_ry_i32_controlled(i32 %8, i32 %9, double %4)
  call void @cqrt_ry_i32_controlled(i32 %8, i32 %9, double %4)

mutants.note: y is measured where the source measures x
fsub_qq measures its first operand instead of the difference

edits.old:
@cq_template_fsub_f64(i32 %5, i32 %6)    ; IR: %7 = fsub double %5, %6
  %8 = call double @cqrt_measure_f64(i32 %7)
edits.new:
@cq_template_fsub_f64(i32 %5, i32 %6)    ; IR: %7 = fsub double %5, %6
  %8 = call double @cqrt_measure_f64(i32 %5)

mutants.note: forward and reverse loops run K-1 = 3 trips (consistently, so the tape balances)
forward and reverse loops run K-1 = 3 trips: the fourth trip's phase and Ry are missing
the nested phase (x > k && x < m) sits on the outer flag (x > k)
the in-loop phase sits on the trip predicate instead of trip && x odd
the then-arm phase moves inside the NOT bracket: it sits on NOT f

edits.old:
call void @cqrt_rz_i1(i32 %12, double %6)    ; IR: block %13: cq_phi(%6)  [phase arm: kickback on f]
  call void @cqrt_not_i1(i32 %12)    ; IR: bracket: block %16 runs under NOT %12
edits.new:
call void @cqrt_not_i1(i32 %12)    ; IR: bracket: block %16 runs under NOT %12
  call void @cqrt_rz_i1(i32 %12, double %6)    ; IR: block %13: cq_phi(%6)  [phase arm: kickback on f]

mutants.note: printf_mixed's classical field c is written to the tape as the literal 7: the printed line changes (review chk-h1 m5, cq-e4jk)
remove_cond's effect entry and its path field are deleted: remove() is never performed where x > k (review chk-h1 m4, cq-e4jk)

x ^= 1 just before its Ry: the Ry acts on a rail holding x0 ^ 1, not the C register's x0 (cq-3o3v); the value after the Ry is the substituted reach's either way, so only the pre-gate value check sees it

edits.new:
call void @cqrt_xorc_i32(i32 %5, i32 1)
  call void @cqrt_ry_i32(i32 %5, double %1)

declare void @cqrt_ry_i32(i32, double)

declare void @cqrt_xorc_i32(i32, i32)
